lines.text: The one who judges others has no excuse, because he does the same things.
A hard, unrepentant heart stores up sorrow against you for the day of God's righteous judgment.
Seekers of glory, honor, and immortality get eternal life; those who reject the truth and follow wickedness get wrath.
Evil brings trouble and good brings glory, first for the Jew then the Greek, because God shows no favoritism.
God will judge men's secrets through Moses, as the gospel proclaims.
